headlines.title: Senate Republicans advance Todd Blanche nomination after ‘anti-weaponization’ fund holdup
headlines.description: Blanche’s nomination had been held up over concerns from GOP Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis, but the parties reached a deal to end the standoff.

headlines.title: Olympic canoeist charged by Jeanine Pirro seeks to permanently sink Reflecting Pool case
headlines.description: Attorneys for the former Olympic canoeist the Trump administration had charged in a felony Reflecting Pool case are seeking to permanently bar any effort to resurface what they called a “politically motivated prosecution” of their client.

headlines.title: Democrats put redistricting amendment on Maryland’s midterm ballot
headlines.description: Maryland’s Democratic-controlled Legislature voted Tuesday to place a constitutional amendment on the November ballot that would pave the way for them to eliminate the state’s lone Republican-held congressional district before the 2028 election.

headlines.title: U.S. Treasury Secy. Bessent says the Strait of Hormuz could reopen 'today or tomorrow'
headlines.description: The White House says a deal to get the Strait of Hormuz back open could be on its way as Treasury Secretary Bessent says he's had talks with Iranians to move to a "more normalized position in this conflict." NBC News' Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Rep. Max Miller calls for House investigation into himself amid abuse allegations
headlines.description: Ohio Rep. Max Miller denies all allegations of domestic abuse by his ex-wife and has called for a House Ethics investigation into himself. Miller said he will not drop his re-election bid. NBC News' Scott Wong reports.

headlines.title: El-Sayed & Stevens ‘have far more in common than they have differences’: Rep. Debbie Dingell
headlines.description: Rep. Debbie Dingell (D-Mich.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss the key primary races in Michigan and the importance of finding common ground to unite the Democratic party ahead of November’s general election.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Missouri secretary of state blocks referendum to undo GOP’s redrawn congressional map
headlines.description: Missouri’s Republican Secretary of State Denny Hoskins said Tuesday that he wouldn’t certify a referendum seeking to undo the state’s new GOP-drawn congressional map, arguing that the effort was unconstitutional.

headlines.title: Two more House Democrats face primary danger: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller requests an ethics investigation into himself
headlines.description: The Ohio Republican, who has been accused of domestic abuse by his ex-wife, said he wants to clear his name: “I have absolutely nothing to hide.”

headlines.title: Trump claims Iran talks are underway as Tehran denies it
headlines.description: President Donald Trump accused Iran of duplicity and insisted the two sides were discussing reopening the Strait of Hormuz as early as Tuesday, even as Tehran denied talks were even taking place.

headlines.title: Feds charge FBI agent they say stole nearly $1 million in crypto from Russia
headlines.description: The FBI supervisory special agent believed the FBI “could not or would not act against adversarial cryptocurrency accounts,” prosecutors said.
